description: This Java source file defines the CommandHandlerProvider class, which provides command handler instances based on entity and action annotations. It manages registration and retrieval of command handlers within the Fineract project.

classes.name: CommandHandlerProvider
classes.description: Provides command handlers for specific entity-action pairs, manages registration via Spring annotations, and retrieves handlers on demand.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the handler registry after bean properties are set.

methods.name: initializeHandlerRegistry
methods.description: Discovers and registers command handler beans annotated with @CommandType.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Retrieves a command handler for a given entity and action, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: setApplicationContext
methods.description: Sets the Spring application context for bean retrieval.
